message.content:
You are a senior frontend engineer + designer. The app's main screen was rebuilt as a calm "Today" flow (web/src/components/Today.tsx, TopBar.tsx, web/src/index.css; design: Instrument Sans, three type sizes, plain light ground, one blue (accent) for the primary action, red (late) only for what misses the trucks, the highlighter only on sources, green (routine) only for routine work, whitespace instead of boxes, no chips/KPI tiles; approved design shots in /Users/jonasstenglein/.claude/jobs/3021cc1a/tmp/brand/shots/20..25-*.png; live app :8000, login form /login, password ASK_DASHBOARD_PASSWORD in .env, never print it). The secondary screens still look like the old dense dashboard. Bring them onto the same design. Work in the repo; do NOT commit or push. You own: web/src/components/DecisionList.tsx, DecisionPane.tsx, LaunchTimeline.tsx, EvidenceDrawer.tsx, SourceAnchors.tsx (styling only; keep exports used by Today.tsx: AnchorCrop, NUM_OR_ID, fileUrl, normTok, useAnchors, Anchor, CitedText, AnchorList, OpenAnchor), SupplyMap.tsx, AlertsButton.tsx, web/src/App.tsx (only the /plan and /suppliers views' layout), index.css (add tokens if needed; do not change the meaning of existing ones), web/public/manifest.webmanifest + icons (PWA icon in the new mark style: see web/public/favicon.svg), and src/ask_soony/basic_auth.py (only the LOGIN_PAGE HTML/CSS: same font, ground, accent; keep behaviour) and src/ask_soony/teams.py (only the Adaptive Card colours/wording if needed). Another engineer works on Today.tsx, lib/today.ts, Routines.tsx, routines/*, VoiceCall.tsx in parallel: do not edit those.

Screens:
1. PLAN (/plan): the launch timeline and the full decision list + detail pane. Make it calm: timeline restyled (hairlines, the "Too late" gutter, red only on stops/late items, no wall of hatching: a stopped stretch as a thin red line or light tint, not dense stripes), the list as quiet rows (dot + headline + time; sections "Needs you", "Waiting on others", "Handled for you" with the green routine line, "Decided by you"), the detail pane like Today's decision (headline, contradiction sentence with tappable sources, recommendation, actions) plus the extra Plan-only parts (all evidence, the trail "How we know", edit the message, escalate) as quiet expandable sections. Keep keyboard j/k and all behaviour.
2. SUPPLIERS (/suppliers): the map calmer (muted land, hairline routes, colour only where something is late/silent), a quiet legend, a simple list of suppliers with their open issues beside or below.
3. EVIDENCE drawer (phone "Show full page") and anchor views: same type and colours, highlighter yellow, no heavy borders.
4. LOGIN page and PWA icon/manifest name "Ask Soony" in the new mark style; Teams card wording calm (no emoji already done; check colours match: accent blue, late red, routine green).
Never click Approve/Escalate/Dismiss on real data; mock with Playwright page.route when you need decided states. Verify: cd web && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && npm run build; uv run pytest -q (for the two Python files) ; screenshots 1440x900 and 390x844 of Plan, Suppliers, evidence, login into /Users/jonasstenglein/.claude/jobs/3021cc1a/tmp/restyle/. Final report with screenshots.
